issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): The UML in the problem statement declares +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (public) while the solution implementation declares it as protected (protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()). This mismatch between the intended public API in the UML and the narrower visibility in the solution can confuse students about the expected accessibility and may cause tests or example usage that rely on a public method to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make getTotalNumberOfStudents() public to match the UML and the intended public API. Update the solution implementation signature to: public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() { ... }. Also update the template guidance (the TODO or method signature hint) to indicate a public method so students implement the same visibility.
